name: Building control, planning and statutory inspection
one_line: The public-authority side of building, held from the APPLICANT's side: the planning and building-regulations applications and the drawings and statements submitted with them, the acknowledgements and reference numbers, the decision notice and its numbered conditions, the discharge of those conditions, the inspection visits and their records, and the completion or final certificate that closes the file. The anchor is a CASE, not a document: an APPLICATION REFERENCE issued by a named authority about a named site, running a lifecycle from validation through decision and condition-discharge to completion. A single authority document with no case sequence around it is NOT this row - it is the householder's own record or Independent Records. Absorbs the legacy row cons.building-control. Placeholder row: it recognises the situation and writes NO field rows, because the construction_property schema declares none (D1 as narrowed, _CONTRACT rules 10 and 15, CONNECTION PR-6).

deterministic: PRECONDITION on every entry below: each is a DETECTION signal and never an extraction licence. This template's schema declares no field rows, so nothing here writes a domain fact. Detection exists so the material is recognised, kept local where the sensitivity setting says so, and offered honestly. “Privacy policy must be enforced before content reaches any model or external connector.”

an AUTHORITY-DECISION structure: a letterhead or issuing block resolving to a planning, building-control or statutory inspection body, together with an application-reference-shaped token in a labelled reference slot, a decision word (granted, approved, refused, rejected, approved subject to conditions), and a numbered schedule of conditions or reasons. The four together are the signal; the authority name alone is never-alone.

an APPLICATION-FORM structure: a statutory form whose issuing body is named, with labelled applicant, agent, site address, proposal description and declaration slots, and an accompanying fee or validation reference. “Tables matter because resumes, forms, applications, invoices, and administrative documents often place their most useful information in cells rather than body paragraphs.”

a CONDITION-DISCHARGE structure: correspondence citing a condition NUMBER against an application reference and submitting the information that condition requires, or the authority's confirmation that it is discharged. The condition-number-against-application-reference pair exists in no other row.

an INSPECTION-VISIT structure: a dated record naming a stage of works inspected (excavation, foundation, damp proof course, drainage, structure, insulation, completion), an outcome or defect note, and an inspector identifier — issued by the authority, not by the contractor.

a COMPLETION or FINAL certificate from the authority: a statement that the works described under a named application reference comply, with an issue date and an authority signature block. This is an authority document and is distinct from an installer's own compliance declaration.
a STATUTORY-CONSULTATION structure: a neighbour notification, a site notice, a consultee response or an objection, each citing the application reference and the site address.

a submitted-drawing pairing: a sheet whose title block status reads for planning or for building regulations, referenced by number in an application form's drawing schedule. The sheet itself is the drawings row's; the pairing with an application reference is this row's.
parent-folder context naming an application reference, a planning or building-control label, or a site address — a clue only, never firing alone.
an email whose labelled sender resolves to an authority domain and whose subject carries an application reference; or a portal notification naming a case and a status change.
an archive whose manifest names an application pack, a submission or a consultation bundle — read from the manifest without extraction.
needs_llm: an unlabelled letter from a council that could be a planning decision, a council-tax matter, an enforcement notice or a highways issue — all arrive on the same letterhead about the same address.
a design and access, heritage or flood-risk statement, which reads as an essay and whose only application evidence may be a single reference line.
distinguishing an ENFORCEMENT communication from an ordinary decision, which changes the sensitivity posture and may make the protected legal side co-activate.
deciding whether the holder is the applicant, the agent, the objecting neighbour or the authority — the same letter reaches all four.

deciding whether an authority document sits inside a live CASE or stands alone. This is the narrowing this row accepted on deepening: a decision notice with an acknowledgement, a condition-discharge exchange and an inspection sequence around it is this row; the same notice alone in a householder's folder is not, and “The graph does not automatically copy those missing facts onto sparse files”.
never_alone: an authority or council name alone. It is 00's multi-role token read across to a public body: “A university name alone should not create a group because Columbia can appear as an authoring school, course provider, target institution, employer, research venue, or merely a cited organization.” A council appears as a planning authority, a landlord, a client, a tax collector, an employer and a service provider, frequently to the same person.

a postal address or a street name alone — the family's constitutional never-alone, set by the construction_property schema row on 00's own reasoning about a university name: “A university name alone should not create a group because Columbia can appear as an authoring school, course provider, target institution, employer, research venue, or merely a cited organization.”
an application-reference-shaped token alone. It is a short structured token in the same space as case, matter, claim and account references across the roster.

a document-type word alone (certificate, drawing, schedule, survey, valuation, report, plan, lease). Each is a work_type VALUE that appears in several worlds; the landed finance.household-property row carries title, inspection, warranty and completion certificate as its own work types. 'Certificate', 'notice', 'approval' and 'inspection' are the four most overloaded words in this family and all four appear on the refused compliance-certificate coverage as well.

a bare 4-digit number alone — 00 warns that file names and documents frequently contain numbers that look like years but are course identifiers, version numbers, build numbers, ZIP codes, or other unrelated values. Here they are also plot, drawing, valuation and unit numbers.

a source_type or extension alone. 00 requires that the engine “treat the file extension as a routing signal rather than an assumption about meaning”, and “Design and creative formats such as PSD, AI, SVG, Figma exports, CAD files, and 3D files should at minimum yield filename, format, dimensions or canvas properties, embedded metadata, layers or artboards where accessible, linked asset names, and preview text; unsupported proprietary formats should be recorded as indexed-but-unreadable rather than silently treated as empty.”
a download session alone. “A session should never be treated as proof of topic”

an authority EMAIL DOMAIN alone, and this is the never-alone the portal era makes most tempting. 00 requires the opposite: rules should “suppress generic hubs such as a personal email address or broad university domain”. A council or approved-inspector domain is exactly such a hub - it carries tax, refuse, housing, highways, licensing and employment mail to the same person from the same sender.

a stage word alone (excavation, foundation, damp proof course, drainage, completion). Each names a stage of works that a contractor's own quality record, a site diary entry and a progress photograph set all use. What is this row's is the stage word inside an AUTHORITY-issued visit record against an application reference; the word by itself belongs to whichever sibling holds the site record.

work_types: supporting statement (design and access, heritage, flood risk, transport)
validation or acknowledgement letter and fee receipt
consultee response, neighbour notification or objection
inspection record or site visit note
grouping_reasons: ONE APPLICATION from submission to decision to discharge to completion — the row's primary group, keyed to the application reference and purpose-coherent across wildly different member types: “The documents are content-incoherent but purpose-coherent.”
one condition and everything submitted to discharge it.
one site's regulatory history across several applications and several owners — the group a conveyancer and a surveyor actually want, and one that spans decades.
one inspection sequence across the stages of one build.

one repeatedly re-downloaded portal document, joined by duplicate_family alone. Authority portals hand out the same PDF on every visit, and “A content-hash match supports deduplication review; a filename match alone does not.”

no group at all is valid: a single decision notice with nothing around it is exactly what the residual library is for. “Independent Records may live under Personal/Independent Records and hold standalone certificates, notices, confirmations, forms, and PDFs that have a durable purpose but no broader group.”
and the stop rules apply: “when members carry irreconcilable course, institution, project, term, or purpose facts” — two applications' papers do not merge because they concern neighbouring plots.

and a group is never a licence to enrich its members: a bare inspection slip or an untitled drawing joined to an application group must not acquire the application from its neighbours - “The graph does not automatically copy those missing facts onto sparse files”.

template.why: Empty by binding contract: a dimension may only branch on a field the same entry's schema declares, and construction_property declares none (D1 as narrowed, _CONTRACT rules 10 and 15, CONNECTION PR-6). That is a contract fact, not a claim that this situation has no shape — it plainly does, and it is recorded here as PROSE for whoever answers the schema row's open_question (NJ-CP-1). The recommendation, held as prose: the PROPERTY or SITE first — this row follows the family default rather than construction-project's job-first reversal, and deliberately so: a site's regulatory history outlives every job, every owner and every applicant, and it is the thing a future purchaser searches for. Then the APPLICATION, then the document function (submission / decision / condition / inspection / completion). Function above date, because a condition number under a month folder is unreadable. Not time-first — “For document and record domains, project, function, or subject usually comes before time because putting year first scatters related work across calendar folders.” And whatever eventually lands stays a recommendation: “The system recommends an order based on the domain template, but the user can reverse, remove, add, or flatten dimensions.”

collides_with.signal: The load-bearing collision on this row, and it is a SIDE collision rather than a topic one: the authority's copy and the applicant's copy of a decision notice are the same document. The discriminating evidence is which side the holder is on — an issuing or deciding authority's letterhead, internal case file, officer report and statutory power supports government; an applicant's or agent's submission, its acknowledgement, and the conditions the holder must discharge supports this row. The application reference appears on both copies and discriminates nothing. Where the role does not settle, neither activates: “Correct abstention is a successful outcome because the product’s goal is reliable organization, not maximum file movement.”

ADDED ON DEEPENING, and it is the edge this row most owed: the branch-root sibling already defers to this row in prose - it lists government.planning-application among the neighbours it did NOT give an edge to, on the ground that the authority-decision structure belongs here - but no edge ran the other way. It does now. The discriminating evidence is WHICH COUNTERPARTY the document is addressed to: a contract sum, a programme, an interim valuation, an instruction, a practical-completion certificate and a final account are bilateral commerce with a party who can be negotiated with, and support the job row; an application reference, a decision word, a numbered conditions schedule, a condition-discharge exchange and a statutory inspection visit are a STATUTORY relationship with a body that is not a party to the contract at all, and support this row. Neither is a stage of the other: a planning permission routinely exists years before any contractor and often produces no job at all (a refusal, a lapsed consent, a lawful-development certificate obtained only to sell), while a job routinely runs under a consent obtained by somebody else. Shared fixture: 'Condition 4 discharge - drainage details.pdf', which the job file holds as correspondence and this row holds as the condition sequence - both readings hold and neither excludes the other.

Same shape, different permit family: a street works permit, a scaffold licence, a skip permit and a hoarding licence are issued by the same bodies about the same sites. The discriminating evidence is whether the instrument approves BUILDING WORKS under a planning or building-regulations regime (this row) or licenses an activity or occupation of the public realm (permit-licensing). An authority name and a site address count for neither.

A householder keeps their own extension's planning permission and completion certificate, and the landed row already lists permit or building approval and completion or compliance certificate among its own work types. The discriminating evidence is whether the material sits inside a live application or inspection sequence with an authority (this row) or is a single durable document kept as part of the household's own record of its own home (finance.household-property). A site address and the word certificate count for neither, and where the role does not settle the household side is the safer home because it is the protected one. Where the role does not settle, neither activates: “Correct abstention is a successful outcome because the product’s goal is reliable organization, not maximum file movement.”

A submitted drawing is both a controlled sheet and an application document. The discriminating evidence for THIS row is the application reference and the form's drawing schedule; for the drawings row it is the title block. Where both are present the file is genuinely both and neither excludes the other — the collision exists to stop a bare title block activating this row.

ADDED ON DEEPENING. A managed block generates recurring statutory evidence - fire-door inspection schedules, a building-safety case, licensing correspondence - and generates applications of its own for roof and window works. The discriminating evidence is whether the document belongs to an APPLICATION CASE with a reference, a decision and conditions (this row) or to the RECURRING management cycle of one building with leaseholders in it (the sibling). A site address, an authority name and the word inspection count for neither. The same roof renewal produces both sets, so this is a per-evidence-item mutex and not a claim about the works - stated in the sibling's own terms so the two do not diverge.

falls_through_to.why: The honest home for a standalone member of this situation with no accepted group around it. “Independent Records may live under Personal/Independent Records and hold standalone certificates, notices, confirmations, forms, and PDFs that have a durable purpose but no broader group.”

The right home when the document is plainly real but its property, instruction or side is unresolved. “Review Later may hold files whose meaning is partly understood but whose final location requires a future decision.”

Where the material carries an occupier's, tenant's or leaseholder's identity, or a commercially confidential figure, the protective home is correct. “Protected Records may represent sensitive isolated material such as passport scans, medical documents, account statements, visas, legal forms, or credentials; it should normally remain local-only and must not cause filenames or content to be exposed in model prompts.”

Standards, guidance notes, market reports and saved technical PDFs accumulate heavily in this world and are not instruction records. “Reading Inbox may hold papers, articles, reports, and saved PDFs that appear to be reading material but have no active research, course, or project association.”
Portal captures and phone photographs of a document on a wall are the tempting false files of this world and belong here when nothing else fires.

Isolated transactional members — a delivery note, a hire confirmation, a fee invoice with nothing around it. “Receipts and Confirmations may hold isolated invoices, delivery confirmations, booking records, boarding passes, purchase receipts, event tickets, and similar transactional documents.”

sensitivity_why: Genuinely mixed, set cautiously, and - on deepening - distinct from the schema's default rather than merely equal to it, which matters because this is one of the two legs the row's node test now rests on. Much of this material is public record by design; a decision notice is published. Against that, three grounds that are NOT the schema's generic posture: (1) THE EXPOSED THIRD PARTY IS A STRANGER. On every other row on this schema the exposed party is a client, a tenant or an occupier - someone in a relationship with the holder. Here the file routinely contains a named neighbour's objection carrying their own home address, and that person is not a party to anything and never consented. (2) ENFORCEMENT CORRESPONDENCE IS AN ALLEGATION AGAINST THE HOLDER, which no other row on this schema carries; it changes the posture of the whole file and may co-activate the protected legal side. (3) THE FILE CONTAINS A COMPLETE INTERNAL LAYOUT OF A REAL, ADDRESSED DWELLING, published alongside its address - an address here is not merely identifying, it is locating. 00's own corpus sentence names material of this kind - the corpus “can include identity documents, account statements, tax records, medical information, legal records, credentials, private correspondence, GPS metadata, employment materials, and educational records”. Where a row is mixed, the stricter setting is the honest one. The handling class is P7's and is not set here.
open_question: Four, one of them new this pass. (1) NJ-CP-6, row-specific and load-bearing: this row is defined by the holder's SIDE, and side is the least reliably extractable thing in the family - a decision notice is byte-comparable in the authority's file and the applicant's. If side cannot be established the honest outcome is abstention on BOTH sides rather than a default to either. Authored one-way here; every government.* row owes the reciprocal, and R1c should collect it. (2) NEW - NJ-CP-7, the CASE threshold. This pass narrowed the row from 'authority documents about building' to 'an application case', because the wider reading is the refused compliance-certificate row wearing a reference number. But 'a case' is a neighbourhood judgement, and _CONTRACT rule 3 forbids inventing a count of members. Alternatives: (a) require the application reference to recur across at least two distinct members - checkable, but a threshold this pass may not author; (b) require one non-decision member (an acknowledgement, a discharge, an inspection) alongside the decision - no number, weaker; (c) leave it to activation confidence. This memo takes (b) as the stated posture and flags (a) for R1c. (3) Jurisdiction, recorded not asked: every term in proposed_context_terms is one regime's vocabulary, and D4 already settles that jurisdiction is a VALUE and never a field or a dimension - so the row is correct as written, but it is the row where a single-jurisdiction gazetteer will most visibly under-serve everyone else. R4 owns the gazetteer. (4) Inherits NJ-CP-1.
